steps.text: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
Did the library forgive you?
The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
A very moving exchange
I think we both grew as people
Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
You look like you're enjoying the silence
For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
How did the morning go?
Fine once I actually started listening
Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
A distracted student? Doesn't sound like you at all
I'm choosing to ignore that 😌
{{name:aiden}} is by the courtyard gate
I told him I'd be there in a minute
Are you still happy to talk to him?
Yes, I just need to stop trying to decide how the whole conversation will go before it starts
One sentence at a time
That's annoyingly sensible
I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
Thank you
A FEW MINUTES LATER
I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
Since when?
You're making an excellent first impression
First impression? I thought I was well past that
Come on, let's walk a little

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.

steps.text: All right, now you actually are making me curious
You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
I appreciate the effort
Is this a good place?
Yeah, let's sit for a minute
You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
What thing?
Twisting it around your fingers
I hadn't noticed
You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you
I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about
Okay
{{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
Wait, what the fuck?
A little quieter, please
Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
Why? Did something happen between you two?
No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
He brought it up?
Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
Neither was I when he first told me
All right, but why are you telling me?
Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
No, the man standing behind you
Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
{{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
I'd have understood the bank faster
That doesn't surprise me
Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
I would hope so
At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
And that's where I came in?
Eventually
Whose idea was that?
We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
Neither until you've actually answered my question
You're enjoying watching me struggle now
A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
All right. Why me?
Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
Both of you?
Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
Oh
Was that the part that finally shut you up?
For a second, yeah
That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
I can still do that
There she is
I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
I noticed the embarrassed part
Of course you did
You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
Clearly that was an oversight
But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
You've noticed, then
You're not nearly as subtle as you think
I was trying to be charming
Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
You're sure?
Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
I appreciate the effort
I like you. An awkward conversation hasn't suddenly made that difficult to admit
Some of us needed a little longer
I noticed
And before you start feeling too pleased with yourself, I'm asking about a first date. Nothing beyond that is decided
I know. A coffee, then we see how it feels
Even if it feels weird?
Then it feels weird. I'm still going to complain about the coffee and steal your fries next week
Ideally without telling the entire table why we went out
Of course. I'm teasing you, not announcing it to everyone
Or making him regret being honest with me
I know. I might need a second not to grin next time I see him, but I'm not going to make him feel bad about it
You really won't?
He trusts me. You've just told me you do too. I'm not going to be an idiot about that
Only about everything else?
Let's not expect miracles
Thank you. Seriously
You're welcome
Coffee tomorrow? There's that place near the campus with the mismatched chairs
The one where you complained the cups were too small?
They were too small
This is already sounding like our normal conversations
I'm trying to ease you in
Tomorrow could work
Want to decide the time later? I need to check when my last class finishes
Yes, message me when you know
Okay
And I might be a little awkward at first
Then I'll give you something to complain about
You do that without trying
See? We have a system
See you tomorrow
See you tomorrow
25 MINUTES LATER
We talked, and he said he'd like to get a coffee with me tomorrow 😊
How are you feeling?
Like I've been holding my shoulders up around my ears since breakfast and only just noticed
You can put them down now
I'm trying
He knows we discussed him together, and that this isn't something I'm hiding from you
We've only agreed on a coffee, nothing beyond that
And did talking to him feel all right?
I left my phone in my bag until we'd finished, like we said
He understands that you know, and we agreed on a coffee without making promises about anything else
I'm glad you could actually concentrate on the conversation
Me too, I already had enough happening inside my head
I'm keeping the small details to myself, like we said
But the important part is good, and he understands that you know
Just a coffee tomorrow, nothing we've decided beyond that
Then tell me how you're feeling rather than giving me the whole conversation
Relieved, and a little pleased with myself
I thought I'd feel like I was borrowing somebody else's confidence
But once I'd said the awkward part, I was still just me
That's the person he knows
Yeah, I think I needed to remember that
And there was a moment when I realized I actually wanted him to say yes
How did that feel?
More personal than when we were just talking about the idea
Not bad, just enough to make me lose my next sentence
You, lost for words? I'm trying very hard not to look too pleased about that
Absolutely not, you'd have made a face and I'd have started laughing
Here, this is the version that has recovered slightly
That's a very good smile
I know, I can't quite get rid of it
You don't have to
You're making me do it again ❤️
He'll let me know his schedule later, then we'll pick a time
Tell me tonight when you're settled
I will, I need to go get something to eat first
I've had a few messages on the app
Anything you feel like answering?
One or two, yes
I'm going to sit somewhere with a drink and actually read them instead of opening everything between doors
Probably more comfortable than standing in the library exit
Much less likely to get me politely removed, too
I'll text you once I've had a chance to talk properly
Okay ❤️
50 MINUTES LATER
I've finished my drink and somehow found a person I wanted to keep talking to
That sounds promising
It was not the man who asked whether I was actually single
I pointed him back to the first sentence of my profile and left that conversation there
An efficient reading comprehension test
Very efficient
But the other conversation was nice
He actually read what I'd written, including the part about you
Did that make it awkward?
He asked if this was something we'd agreed on, I said yes, and he didn't keep trying to turn it into a secret
Then we got to have an ordinary conversation, which was the part I wanted
What made you answer him?
One of his pictures was a very burnt pizza with an apology underneath it
So you chose him for his cooking
I chose him because it made me laugh, which seemed like a reasonable place to start
His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
Better than asking whether you're single
A significant improvement
I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
Because of the pizza?
Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
You don't have to let him cook for you
I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
That sounds sensible of him
He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
That's enough for now, then
I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
Exactly
By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
Already picked somewhere?
I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
Does that feel like something you want to do?
Yes
I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
You sound happy about that
I am
I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
That sounds more like you
It felt like me, too
And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
You look pleased with yourself
I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
You can have more than five
Dangerous, I might become unbearable
I'll take the risk
This photo is for you, by the way
I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
I'll treasure the exclusive
I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
Tell me tonight
I will ❤️
Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
I haven't forgotten you for a second
But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
That is painfully believable
Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
Happy to help
Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
